lines.text: David tells the assembly that Solomon is young and inexperienced, and he gives three thousand talents of Ophir gold.
The leaders give willingly, and whoever has precious stones brings them to the treasury, and the people and David rejoice.
David blesses the LORD before the assembly and says everything comes from God's hand and that God tests the tongue.
The assembly blesses the LORD, then offers a thousand bulls, rams and lambs, and anoints Solomon with Abiathar as priest.
Solomon sits on the throne and prospers, and David dies after reigning forty years, seven of them in Hebron.
